acceptance_criteria.criterion: ledger_get_next_action with agent_role: 'Project Manager' returns handoff_status in WAIT responses
handoff_status includes auto_handoff when the agent registry is loaded

All pre-existing tests continue to pass after this change

summary: Wrapped the 'Project Manager' switch case in workflow-next-action.ts with embedHandoffStatusInWait, matching the pattern used by all other agent roles.

Added one unit test in the 'handoff_status embedded in WAIT responses' describe block: sets up an IN_PROGRESS WP with an active pipeline so PM falls through to WAIT, then asserts result.handoff_status is defined and current_agent is 'Project Manager'.
All 983 tests pass (982 pre-existing + 1 new). No regressions.

comments.note: getProjectManagerAction (workflow-next-action.ts ~line 291) re-fetches all WP details via its own Promise.all, even though the outer scope already loaded wpDetails at line 75. Aligning its signature with getDeveloperAction/getQaAction/etc. (accepting pre-loaded wpDetails as an optional param) would eliminate this redundant I/O. Flagged in the plan as a separate micro-debt item; out of scope for this WP.

The Synthesis case in the switch statement constructs an inline object literal rather than delegating to a named getSynthesisAction() function, unlike all other cases. Minor inconsistency that could be extracted for uniformity.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified. 983/983 tests pass (982 pre-existing + 1 new PM WAIT handoff test). Build clean.
Implementation correctly wraps the 'Project Manager' switch case with embedHandoffStatusInWait at lines 216-222 of workflow-next-action.ts, matching the pattern for all other agent roles.
New test at tests/tools/workflow-next-action.test.ts lines 1503-1527 asserts PM WAIT responses carry handoff_status with current_agent='Project Manager'.
Non-WAIT PM paths (CREATE_WORK_PACKAGES, SIGNAL_SYNTHESIS) correctly bypass embedding. Error resilience confirmed via try/catch in embedHandoffStatusInWait.

comments.note: The CREATE_WORK_PACKAGES and SIGNAL_SYNTHESIS early-return paths for PM return raw MCP response objects without embedHandoffStatusInWait — intentional and correct since neither is a WAIT action. No test explicitly asserts absence of handoff_status on those paths, but the embedHandoffStatusInWait early-return guard (action !== WAIT) provides the coverage implicitly.

summary: Fix is minimal, surgical, and architecturally consistent. The 'Project Manager' switch case now wraps getProjectManagerAction with embedHandoffStatusInWait, matching the established pattern for all other agent roles.
Early-return paths (CREATE_WORK_PACKAGES, SIGNAL_SYNTHESIS) correctly predate the switch and return non-WAIT actions — the embedHandoffStatusInWait guard provides a safe backstop.
Pre-loaded opts (store, rootIndex, wpDetails) are correctly forwarded to avoid redundant reads.

New PM WAIT unit test drives through all PM priority rules to WAIT via a non-stale IN_PROGRESS pipeline, then asserts handoff_status shape. All 5 acceptance criteria met. 983/983 tests pass. No blocking issues.

comments.note: Non-blocking (pre-existing debt): getProjectManagerAction re-fetches wpDetails internally via its own Promise.all even though the outer scope already loaded them and forwards them as opts. Aligning it with getDeveloperAction/getQaAction to accept pre-loaded wpDetails would eliminate N redundant disk reads per PM call. Should be tracked as a separate micro-debt item — already flagged in implementation pipeline.

Non-blocking (pre-existing inconsistency): The Synthesis case in the switch constructs an inline object literal rather than delegating to a getSynthesisAction() function, unlike all other agent-role cases. Minor uniformity gap; no functional impact.

summary: Updated the stale computeHandoffStatus usage comment in mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md (line 1721). The comment previously listed only 'Developer, QA, Reviewer' as the agent roles for which handoff_status is embedded in WAIT responses. It now correctly lists all six roles: 'Project Manager, Developer, QA, Reviewer, Documentation, Synthesis', reflecting the complete set handled by embedHandoffStatusInWait after this WP's implementation change.
